name: Uno Protoshield + Mini Breadboard
description: Expansion shield that plugs directly onto Arduino Uno headers with a 170-tie-point mini breadboard and custom prototyping pads.
realWorldAnalogy: Expansion shield that plugs directly onto Arduino Uno headers with a 170-tie-point mini breadboard and custom prototyping pads.

pinout.description: Full Uno pin breakout D0-D13, A0-A5, Power, GND

hazards: Ensure shield header pins are aligned before pressing into Uno

datasheetRef: UNO Proto Shield Prototype Expansion Board.pdf
wiringGuidance: Align all pins with Uno female headers and press down gently and evenly. Peel the backing off the mini breadboard to stick it onto the shield's solder pad area.
commonMistakes: Bending header pins by pressing down at an uneven angle.
Shorting soldered components underneath the shield against the Uno's metal USB jack.

miniExperiment.title: Shield Status Test
miniExperiment.circuit: Plug Protoshield onto Uno. Connect jumper wire from D13 header to LED1 anode on the shield.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The shield LED blinks on and off rhythmically.
